title: Inertia of a fibred groupoid and its flat locally finitely presented projection
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] within [def-weil-size-convention], and let $\mathcal F\to\mathit{Sch}/S$ be a category fibred in groupoids with the 2-base-change conventions of [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids]. Its inertia category $I_{\mathcal F/S}$ has objects $(x,\alpha)$, where $x$ is an object of $\mathcal F$ and $\alpha:x\xrightarrow{\sim}x$ lies over the identity of its base scheme. An arrow $(x,\alpha)\to(y,\beta)$ is an arrow $f:x\to y$ satisfying $f\alpha=\beta f$. The base projection is that of $x$; the canonical projection $I_{\mathcal F/S}\to\mathcal F$ forgets $\alpha$. Say this projection is representable by algebraic spaces, flat and locally of finite presentation if, for every scheme $T$ over $S$ and map $h_T\to\mathcal F$, the 2-base change is presented by an algebraic space $Z$ [def-trf-algebraic-space] with its actual projection $p:Z\to T$, and for every representable etale scheme chart $a:U\to Z$ the scheme map $pa:U\to T$ is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. The presentation of the 2-base change retains its projection as in the chart conventions of [def-sfb-algebraic-moduli-stack].
